title: Jeremy Gandon birdies final three holes to win LECOM Suncoast Classic - PGA TOUR
snippet: Jeremy Gandon made birdie on his final three holes and posts a final-round 65 to win the LECOM Suncoast Classic at Lakewood National Golf Club.
extractedText: 7D AGOJeremy Gandon birdies final three holes to win LECOM Suncoast Classic1 Min ReadDaily Wrap UpJeremy Gandon makes birdie on No. 18 at Compliance SolutionsAChange Text SizeWritten by Staff Jeremy Gandon made birdie on his final three holes and posts a final-round 65 to win the LECOM Suncoast Classic at Lakewood National Golf Club. a playoff victory over Rick Lamb at the 2025 Club Car Championship at The Landings Golf & Athletic Club, where he followed three-time Korn Ferry Tour winner Paul Barjon as the second player
